buckets.evidence_notes: Public Access Block partially or fully disabled; Bucket policy grants public access

cis_results.title: Ensure S3 Bucket Access is Not Public
cis_results.evidence: Bucket 'company-public-marketing-assets' in region 'us-east-1' is publicly accessible. Findings: public bucket policy allows world access; ACL grants public Read/Write permissions; Public Access Block is disabled or incomplete.
cis_results.reference: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v1.4.0 - Section 2.1.1 (v3.0.0 - 2.1.4)

cis_results.title: Ensure S3 Bucket Default Encryption is Enabled
cis_results.evidence: Bucket 'company-public-marketing-assets' is encrypted at rest using SSE-S3 (AES256).
cis_results.reference: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v1.4.0 - Section 2.1.2 (v3.0.0 - 2.1.1)

cis_results.title: Ensure MFA is Enabled for the 'root' User Account
cis_results.evidence: The root user account for AWS account 123456789012 does NOT have Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) enabled.
cis_results.remediation: Sign into the AWS Management Console as the root user. Navigate to IAM > Security Credentials > Assign MFA Device to configure a virtual or hardware token.
cis_results.reference: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v1.4.0 - Section 1.5 (v3.0.0 - 1.5)

cis_results.title: Ensure CloudTrail is Enabled Across All Regions
cis_results.evidence: No active multi-region CloudTrail was found logging management events across all regions. Actions in unmonitored regions cannot be audited.
cis_results.remediation: aws cloudtrail create-trail --name multi-region-security-trail --s3-bucket-name <your-audit-bucket> --is-multi-region-trail && aws cloudtrail start-logging --name multi-region-security-trail
cis_results.reference: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v1.4.0 - Section 3.1 (v3.0.0 - 3.1)

cis_results.title: Ensure No Security Groups Allow Ingress to SSH (Port 22) from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0
cis_results.evidence: Security Group 'web-dmz-sg' (sg-0192837465abc1234) allows inbound TCP port 22 (SSH) from unrestricted sources (0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0). Exposed to internet-wide brute-force attacks.
cis_results.reference: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v1.4.0 - Section 4.1 (v3.0.0 - 5.1)
